favourite.heading: Why Washington can pull away
bullets: Washington is the better football team by 11.9 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 74% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+11.9 pts).
Playing at Washington is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).
Stylistically the matchup favours Washington by 1.0 points: ball control vs front disruption (+1.0 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Minnesota can keep it close
bullets: The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 -6.0 to p90 +38.0 for Washington, so a projection of +17.0 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.
College ratings are built on twelve-game seasons against wildly uneven schedules; even a clean rating gap carries more estimation error than the number implies.
